title: Concept: absent Content-Security-Policy
description: No Content-Security-Policy is present, so the browser has no source restriction to apply to scripts, styles, frames or connections and any injected script runs with the page's full authority. This record covers the absence of a policy, not the quality of one that is present.
applicability: HTML responses served to browser clients.
risk: No browser-side containment of injected script; MEDIUM severity because the impact depends on an injection existing.
